At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

For manufacturing & industrial teams, these are the three workflows we would look at first:

Manufacturing & industrial: where a pilot could start
  01: Quotation preparation
  02: Materials expediting
  03: Quality documentation

Our manufacturing & industrial page puts it like this: “Connect enquiries, materials and quality records across the order lifecycle. Give planners, buyers and engineers the information they need without another round of spreadsheet reconciliation.” For each workflow it sets out the request, the work, who keeps authority and the evidence that closes the case. There is also a calculator for putting a value on the time at your own case volumes.
